paper.description: Paper: read and edit Paper design files, pages, nodes, styles, and tokens (requires Paper Desktop running)

ambient.description: Ambient: my private memory of projects, people, decisions and recurring workflows, recent activity and redacted capture. Search it before work on my projects; save durable facts with memory_save.

mobbin.description: Mobbin: search real app screens, multi-step flows, and website sections from shipped products for design reference (OAuth handled by mcp-remote)

browse.description: Browse: drive your real Chrome-family browser (logins, extensions, open tabs) through the browse extension
